 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u034/system/state/workspace/programs/task-07baa4c0.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter, deque

def _components(grid, bg):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            out.append((color, cells))
    return out

def _is_l(cells):
    rs = [r for r, c in cells]
    cs = [c for r, c in cells]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
    hh, ww = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    return (hh > 1 and ww > 1 and len(cells) == hh + ww - 1 and
            (all((r, c0) in cells for r in range(r0, r1+1)) and all((r0, c) in cells for c in range(c0, c1+1)) or
             all((r, c1) in cells for r in range(r0, r1+1)) and all((r0, c) in cells for c in range(c0, c1+1)) or
             all((r, c0) in cells for r in range(r0, r1+1)) and all((r1, c) in cells for c in range(c0, c1+1)) or
             all((r, c1) in cells for r in range(r0, r1+1)) and all((r1, c) in cells for c in range(c0, c1+1))))

def transform(grid):
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps = _components(grid, bg)
    keys = [(color, cells) for color, cells in comps if _is_l(cells)]
    if not keys:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    key_color, key = max(keys, key=lambda x: len(x[1]))
    n = len(key)
    targets = [(color, cells) for color, cells in comps if color != key_color and len(cells) == n]
    if not targets:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    kr = sum(r for r, c in key) / n
    kc = sum(c for r, c in key) / n
    color, cells = max(targets, key=lambda x: (sum((r-kr)**2 + (c-kc)**2 for r,c in x[1]) / len(x[1])))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = key_color
    return out
"
